inspection_summary: Inspected all 5,894 splitlines of the 103-page normalized lecture notes. The source develops a common trace-formula viewpoint from integrable and chaotic dynamics through the Selberg and Riemann explicit formulas, then uses diagonal/off-diagonal spectral-correlation methods to contrast generic random-matrix universality with arithmetic Poisson statistics. Formula extraction is imperfect in places, but the selected mechanisms are recoverable from checked prose and bounded displayed equations; formula-sensitive reuse should verify the retained PDF.

accepted_units.title: Three responses to analytical intractability
accepted_units.why_material: Relates difficult models by tractable analogues, replaces singular exact quantities by smoothed observables, and organizes spectra into ensembles whose shared statistics define universality.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes the chapter-level comparison among Selberg, Riemann-zero, and arithmetic-surface problems.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Prose-dominant; no formula reconstruction required.

accepted_units.title: Poisson summation turns quantum lattice labels into periodic orbits
accepted_units.why_material: The rectangular billiard makes explicit how Fourier duality separates a smooth density term from oscillatory terms indexed by classical periodic-orbit lengths.
accepted_units.context_note: Retains the density definition, Poisson formula, orbit-length identification, and semiclassical Bessel asymptotics.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-sensitive but coherent in extracted text; verify displayed constants against PDF for exact reuse.

accepted_units.title: Density of states as the imaginary trace of the resolvent
accepted_units.why_material: Replaces dependence on explicit eigenvalue formulas by a Green-function representation that becomes the general starting point for trace formulas.
accepted_units.context_note: The free-space Green-function calculation supplies boundary prescription and normalization context before the trace identity.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Several displayed formulas have extraction risk; conceptual chain is explicit in prose.

accepted_units.title: Quotient geometry implemented by summing Green-function images
accepted_units.why_material: Shows that a fundamental-domain Green function is produced from the covering-space kernel by summing group images, with the identity image furnishing the local singularity.
accepted_units.context_note: The rectangular quotient is the concrete prototype later generalized to hyperbolic discrete groups.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Text and equations are mutually supporting; minor formula-layout risk.

accepted_units.title: Trace-formula divergence is repaired by test-function smoothing
accepted_units.why_material: Explains why naive orbit sums are not mathematical objects and how rapid decay of Fourier harmonics makes the smoothed trace convergent.
accepted_units.context_note: Distinguishes formal cutoff calculations from a well-defined test-function identity.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Prose-dominant.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: One dual architecture, four trace-formula regimes
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Across a torus, hyperbolic quotient, generic integrable/chaotic system, and the Riemann zeta function, a smoothed spectral side is dual to classical or arithmetic primitive data, while exactness and orbit organization change with the regime.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: This is a structural comparison, not evidence that Riemann zeros are eigenvalues of a known Hamiltonian; formula conventions differ and require PDF checking.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Off-diagonal information is a correlation problem in the dual data
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Equal-action pairing supplies only short-time behavior; longer-range spectral information depends on correlations among nearby prime powers or among modular length multiplicities, which can be attacked by rational-phase generating-function singularities.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: Both Hardy-Littlewood uses are heuristic/conditional in these lectures, and dynamical transfer beyond the arithmetic cases is not established.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Arithmeticity changes quantum statistics through exact phase coincidences
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Bounded algebraic conjugates make trace values sparse, forcing exponentially many periodic geodesics to share lengths; their coherent contributions drive a classically chaotic arithmetic surface toward Poisson spectral statistics and coexist with a commuting Hecke algebra.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The source presents degeneracy and Hecke structure as complementary explanations but explicitly denies a precise equivalence; the exact correlation calculation is modular-group-specific.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: The degeneracy exponent is a boundary between harmless and order-one interference
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: Arithmetic mean multiplicity grows at the critical exponent one half, allowing the form factor to reach order one within the diagonal approximation's validity, whereas subcritical exponential degeneracy in non-arithmetic triangles can remain compatible with GOE statistics.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: The non-arithmetic exponents come from short-range numerical fits and the threshold argument is semiclassical and diagonal, not a theorem about all spectral statistics.
